content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of purchase quotes.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to purchase quotes.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for purchase quotes.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of purchase quotes. You can include quotation validity periods, terms, or any other relevant information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing purchase quotes using this footer will not be affected.
